```{R}
library(ANCOMBC)
library(tidyverse)
library(phyloseq)
library(qiime2R)
library(DT)
library(mia)
```

Lets get the data 
```{R}
#set working directory
setwd("/Users/sterlingbutler/Desktop/RICA_FILES_03262025")

#import the feature table using the read_q2biom()
asv<- read_q2biom("table.biom")

#import the taxa file as a qiime2 artifact and then convert it into a usable tax table for phyloseq
tax <- read_qza("taxonomy.qza")

taxa <- tax$data %>% as_tibble() %>% 
  separate(Taxon, sep=";", c("Kingdom", "Phylum", "Class", "Order", "Family", "Genus", "Species")) %>% 
  select(-Confidence) %>% arrange(Feature.ID) %>% mutate(ASV = 1:n()) %>% 
  mutate(newcol = "ASV") %>%
  unite("ASVs", newcol:ASV)

#fixing the taxa table by replacing NAs cells with lowest assigned taxa 
# fill in the empty cells with the Taxa table 
fill_taxonomy <- function(row) {
  last_known <- ""
  for (i in 1:8) {  # Loop through taxonomy columns only
    if (is.na(row[i]) || row[i] == "") {
      row[i] <- paste0(last_known, "_unclassified")
    } else {
      last_known <- row[i]
    }
  }
  return(row)
}

taxa <- as.data.frame(t(apply(taxa, 1, fill_taxonomy)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


head(taxa)
```

Filtering out likely chloroplast reads, blasted qiime2 output seq for each of these ASVs 
```{R}

taxa <- taxa %>% filter(ASVs!="ASV_729") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1498") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1175") %>% 
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1010") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1024") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_546") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_860") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1643") %>%
  filter(ASVs!="ASV_1235")
```

Convert dataframes to be compatable for phyloseq
```{R}
#make the taxa table into a data frame 
taxa<-as.data.frame(taxa)

#import the meta data
meta_df<-read.csv("qiime2_08022024_16S_RICA_META.csv")

#make the correct column names for the phyloseq object 
taxa1 = taxa %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("Feature.ID")
meta = meta_df %>% tibble::column_to_rownames("sample")

#convert the taxa table back into a matrix, so phyloseq can read
tax_mat = as.matrix(taxa1)

#make the individual phyloseq objects otu_table, tax_table, sample_data
otu<-otu_table(asv, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)
tax_table<-tax_table(tax_mat)
sample<-sample_data(meta)

```

Lets make the phyloseq object (taxa, count, meta)
```{R}
#lets make that phyloseq object now
phy= phyloseq(otu, tax_table, sample)

#remove Mitochondria/ chloroplast
phy <- phy %>% subset_taxa( Family!= "Mitochondria" | is.na(Family) & Class!="Chloroplast" | is.na(Class) ) 

#remove NTC and a sample with 20 total reads 
#phy <-phy %>% subset_samples(Species!="NA")
phy <-phy %>% subset_samples(Bag_Number!="32")

## Basic summary information for the phyloseq object that you just created
#number of taxa
ntaxa(phy)
#number of samples
nsamples(phy)
#number of variables
sample_variables(phy)

```

```{R}

#filter out the noise in the data, this filters out any taxa that have counts less than 0
phy_fill= filter_taxa(phy , function(x) sum(x > 2) > (0.03*length(x)), TRUE)
## Basic summary information for the phyloseq object that you just created
#number of taxa
ntaxa(phy_fill)
#number of samples
nsamples(phy_fill)

```


```{R}

df_ra   <- phy_fill %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) {x/sum(x)} ) %>% # Transform to rel. abundance
  psmelt()

```
```{R}
#finding the relative abundace of spiro 

df  <- phy_fill %>%
  tax_glom(taxrank = "Genus") %>%
  transform_sample_counts(function(x) {x/sum(x)} ) %>% # Transform to rel. abundance
  psmelt()


phy_spiro_yes <- subset(df,structural_zero_spiro == "SP" )

phy_spiro_no <-  subset(df, structural_zero_spiro == "SNP")



#SP
Spiro_yes_abundance <- subset(phy_spiro_yes, OTU == c("3aa965194c47dee2ebb9ad04c942930a", "7cf1379d940287bd940fa3da47d76c09"))


spiro_mean_yes <- mean(Spiro_yes_abundance$Abundance)
spiro_sd_yes <-sd(Spiro_yes_abundance$Abundance)

s_yes_t1 <- subset(Spiro_yes_abundance, Time_Point == "T1")
s_yes_t1_mean <- mean(s_yes_t1$Abundance)
s_yes_t1_SD <- sd(s_yes_t1$Abundance)

s_yes_t2 <- subset(Spiro_yes_abundance, Time_Point == "T2")
s_yes_t2_mean <- mean(s_yes_t2$Abundance)
s_yes_t2_SD <- sd(s_yes_t2$Abundance)


#SNP
Spiro_no_abundance <- phy_spiro_no %>% filter(OTU==c("3aa965194c47dee2ebb9ad04c942930a", "7cf1379d940287bd940fa3da47d76c09"))

spiro_mean_no <- mean(Spiro_no_abundance$Abundance)
spiro_sd_no <-sd(Spiro_no_abundance$Abundance)

s_no_t1 <- subset(Spiro_no_abundance, Time_Point == "T1")
s_no_t1_mean <- mean(s_no_t1$Abundance)
s_no_t1_SD <- sd(s_no_t1$Abundance)

s_no_t2 <- subset(Spiro_no_abundance, Time_Point == "T2")
s_no_t2_mean <- mean(s_no_t2$Abundance)
s_no_t2_SD <- sd(s_no_t2$Abundance)

```

```{R}

supp.labs <- c("Baseline Conditions", "Elevated Temperature")
names(supp.labs) <- c("T1", "T2")

supp.labs2 <- c( "Non-Spiro Present Genotypes (SNP)", "Spiro Present Genotypes (SP)")
names(supp.labs2) <- c("No", "Yes")


df_ra %>%
  filter(Abundance >0.005) %>%
filter(Family!=" f__Fokiniaceae") %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "o__", ""))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "f__", ""))) %>%
mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "c__", ""))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "k__", ""))) %>%
   mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "_unclassified", " unclassified"))) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ str_replace_all(.x, "JGI_0000069-P22", "Candidatus Gracilibacteria"))) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x =a_Genotype, y=Abundance, fill=Family)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", position="fill", aes(fill = Family)) + 
  facet_grid(Time_Point~structural_zero_spiro, scales = "free",
             labeller = labeller(Time_Point = supp.labs, structural_zero_spiro = supp.labs2 ))+
  
  scale_fill_manual(values=c( "#56B4E9","#CBD588", "orange","#DA5724","#CD9BCD",
    "gray80", "#AD6F3B", "green","#D14285", "#652926","#8569D5", 
    "#5E738F","#D1A33D", "#8A7C64","lightsalmon","aquamarine4",
    "lightblue4", "lightpink", "ivory4","royalblue4", "darkorchid", 
    "palevioletred1", "#56B4E9","#CBD588","yellow2","#5F7FC7", "orange","#DA5724",
    "#CD9BCD", "gray80",
    "#AD6F3B" )) +
  theme_classic2()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size=9),
        strip.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size=9),
        axis.title= element_text(size = 14),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 14)) +
  
  
  labs(
    x = "Genotypes",
    y = "Abundance",
  fill = "Taxa")

ggsave("relativeAbundance_spiro.png", width = 10, height = 10.5)

```
